arxiv-2103-02691.title: Natural Language Understanding for Argumentative Dialogue Systems in the Opinion Building Domain
arxiv-2103-02691.creator: Waheed Ahmed Abro, Annalena Aicher, Niklas Rach, Stefan Ultes, Wolfgang Minker, Guilin Qi
arxiv-2103-02691.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Waheed Ahmed Abro, Annalena Aicher, Niklas Rach, Stefan Ultes, Wolfgang Minker, Guilin Qi. This paper introduces a natural language understanding (NLU) framework for argumentative dialogue systems in the information-seeking and opinion building domain. The proposed framework consists of two sub-models, namely intent classifier and argument similarity.

arxiv-2201-05798.title: AI-Assisted Design Concept Exploration Through Character Space Construction
arxiv-2201-05798.creator: Shin Sano 1,3∗ and Seiji Yamada 1,2
arxiv-2201-05798.description: Abstract We propose an AI-assisted design concept exploration tool, the “Character Space Construction” (“CSC”). Concept designers explore and articulate the target product aesthetics and semantics in language, which is expressed using “Design Concept Phrases” (“DCPs”), that is, compound adjective phrases, and contrasting terms that convey what are not their target design concepts.

arxiv-2202-07290.title: Don’t stop the training: continuously-updating self-supervised algorithms best account for auditory responses in the cortex
arxiv-2202-07290.creator: Pierre Orhan
arxiv-2202-07290.description: Abstract Over the last decade, numerous studies have shown that deep neural networks exhibit sensory representations similar to those of the mammalian brain, in that their activations linearly map onto cortical responses to the same sensory inputs. However, it remains unknown whether these artificial networks also learn like the brain.

arxiv-2211-16652.title: Canards in a bottleneck
arxiv-2211-16652.creator: Annalisa Iuorio, Gaspard Jankowiak, Peter Szmolyan, Marie-Therese Wolfram
arxiv-2211-16652.description: Abstract In this paper we investigate the stationary profiles of a nonlinear Fokker-Planck equation with small diffusion and nonlinear in- and outflow boundary conditions. We consider corridors with a bottleneck whose width has a global nondegenerate minimum in the interior. In the small diffusion limit the profiles are obtained constructively by using methods from geometric singular perturbation theory (GSPT).

arxiv-2212-01480.title: An efficient numerical algorithm for the moment neural activation
arxiv-2212-01480.creator: Yang Qi
arxiv-2212-01480.description: Abstract Derived from spiking neuron models via the diffusion approximation, the moment activation (MA) faithfully captures the nonlinear coupling of correlated neural variability. However, numerical evaluation of the MA faces significant challenges due to a number of ill-conditioned Dawson-like functions.

arxiv-2301-06534.title: Stuck in the Permissions With You: Developer & End-User Perspectives on App Permissions & Their Privacy Ramifications Conference: Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 23–28, 2023; Hamburg, Germany Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors
arxiv-2301-06534.creator: Mohammad Tahaei, Ruba Abu-Salma, Awais Rashid
arxiv-2301-06534.description: Abstract . While the literature on permissions from the end-user perspective is rich, there is a lack of empirical research on why developers request permissions, their conceptualization of permissions, and how their perspectives compare with end-users’ perspectives. Our study aims to address these gaps using a mixed-methods approach.

arxiv-2403-02328.title: Strong Thermomechanical Noise Squeezing Stabilized by Feedback
arxiv-2403-02328.creator: Aida Mashaal, Lucio Stefan, Andrea Ranfagni, Letizia Catalini, Ilia Chernobrovkin, Thibault Capelle, Eric C. Langman, Albert Schliesser
arxiv-2403-02328.description: Abstract Squeezing the quadrature noise of a harmonic oscillator enhances its sensitivity. Stabilization of the anti-squeezed quadrature can overcome the 3 dB limit of squeezing by parametric modulation. Here, we apply this method to soft-clamped membrane resonators, which hold promise for both classical and quantum sensing applications.

arxiv-2405-15371.title: Engineering Optimal Parallel Task Scheduling
arxiv-2405-15371.creator: Matthew Akram, Nikolai Maas, Peter Sanders, Dominik Schreiber
arxiv-2405-15371.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Matthew Akram, Nikolai Maas, Peter Sanders, Dominik Schreiber. The NP-hard scheduling problem P | | C max P||C_{\mathrm{max}} encompasses a set of tasks with known execution time which must be mapped to a set of identical machines such that the overall completion time is minimized. In this work, we improve existing techniques for optimal P | | C max P||C_{\mathrm{max}} scheduling with a combination of new theoretical insights and careful practical engineering.

arxiv-2409-10372.title: Integrated Design and Governance of Agentic AI Systems through Adaptive Information Modulation
arxiv-2409-10372.creator: Qiliang Chen, Sepehr Ilami, Nunzio Lore, Babak Heydari
arxiv-2409-10372.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Qiliang Chen, Sepehr Ilami, Nunzio Lore, Babak Heydari. Modern engineered systems increasingly involve complex sociotechnical environments where multiple agents—including humans and the emerging paradigm of agentic AI powered by large language models—must navigate social dilemmas that pit individual interests against collective welfare. As engineered systems evolve toward multi-agent architectures with autonomous LLM-based agents, traditional governance approaches using static rules or fixed network structures fail to address the dynamic uncertainties inherent in real-world operations.

arxiv-2409-17720.title: Scene Understanding in Pick-and-Place Tasks: Analyzing Transformations Between Initial and Final Scenes
arxiv-2409-17720.creator: Seraj Ghasemi 1 , Hamed Hosseini 1 , MohammadHossein Koosheshi 1 , Mehdi Tale Masouleh 1 , and Ahmad Kalhor 1
arxiv-2409-17720.description: Abstract With robots increasingly collaborating with humans in everyday tasks, it is important to take steps toward robotic systems capable of understanding the environment. This work focuses on scene understanding to detect pick-and-place tasks given initial and final images from the scene. To this end, a dataset is collected for object detection and pick-and-place task detection.

arxiv-2411-15422.title: Learning a Local Trading Strategy: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Grid-scale Renewable Energy Integration
arxiv-2411-15422.creator: Caleb Ju, Constance Crozier
arxiv-2411-15422.description: Abstract Variable renewable generation increases the challenge of balancing power supply and demand. Grid-scale batteries co-located with generation can help mitigate this misalignment. This paper explores the use of reinforcement learning (RL) for operating grid-scale batteries co-located with solar power.

arxiv-2502-07833.title: Quantitative analysis of the value of investment in research facilities, with examples from cyberinfrastructure
arxiv-2502-07833.creator: Winona G. Snapp-Childs
arxiv-2502-07833.description: Abstract Abstract Purpose: How much to invest in research facilities has long been a question in higher education and research policy. We present established and recently developed techniques for assessing the quantitative value created or received as a result of investments in research facilities. This discussion is timely.

arxiv-2506-03622.title: Beamforming for Secure RSMA-Aided ISAC Systems Thanks: Manuscript received.
arxiv-2506-03622.creator: Qian Dan, Hongjiang Lei, Ki-Hong Park, Gaofeng Pan
arxiv-2506-03622.description: Abstract This work investigates the physical layer security of rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA)-aided integrated communication and sensing (ISAC) systems. The ISAC base station (BS) transmits signals to communicate with users in an eavesdropped scenario and to estimate the parameters of the sensed targets.

arxiv-2506-16035.title: Vision-Guided Chunking Is All You Need: Enhancing RAG with Multimodal Document Understanding
arxiv-2506-16035.creator: name=Vishesh Tripathi ∘, name=Tanmay Odapally ∘, name=Indraneel Das ∘, name=Uday Allu †, name=Biddwan Ahmed †
arxiv-2506-16035.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have revolutionized information retrieval and question answering, but traditional text-based chunking methods struggle with complex document structures, multi-page tables, embedded figures, and contextual dependencies across page boundaries. We present a novel multimodal document chunking approach that leverages Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) to process PDF documents in batches while maintaining semantic coherence and structural integrity.

arxiv-2511-03363.title: A Modular, Data-Free Pipeline for Multi-Label Intention Recognition in Transportation Agentic AI Applications Journal: Expert Systems with Applications
arxiv-2511-03363.creator: Xiaocai Zhang, Hur Lim, Ke Wang, Zhe Xiao, Jing Wang, Kelvin Lee, Xiuju Fu, Zheng Qin
arxiv-2511-03363.description: Abstract In this study, a modular, data-free pipeline for multi-label intention recognition is proposed for agentic AI applications in transportation. Unlike traditional intent recognition systems that depend on large, annotated corpora and often struggle with fine-grained, multi-label discrimination, our approach eliminates the need for costly data collection while enhancing the accuracy of multi-label intention understanding.

pmc-13305683.title: 连续射频术与脉冲射频术治疗老年胸段带状疱疹后神经痛的临床疗效比较
pmc-13305683.creator: 诗雨 王, 锁良 王, 欢 王, 辉 王, 会勇 聂
pmc-13305683.description: 目的带状疱疹后神经痛(postherpetic neuralgia，PHN)是带状疱疹感染后常见的远期并发症，严重影响患者生存质量。本研究旨在比较连续射频术(continuous radiofrequency，CRF)与脉冲射频术(pulsed radiofrequency，PRF)治疗老年PHN患者的临床疗效差异。方法纳入2020年3月至2022年3月于西安交通大学第一附属医院疼痛科接受胸段脊神经背根神经节CRF(CRF组，n=101)或PRF(PRF组，n=80)治疗的181例PHN住院老年患者。分别于术后1周、1个月、3个月、6个月及12个月对患者进行随访，记录其疼痛程度[采用视觉模拟评分(Visual Analogue Scale，VAS)评估]、睡眠质量[采用阿森斯失眠量表(Athens Insomnia Scale，AIS)评估]，以及焦虑[采用广泛性焦虑障碍7项(Generalized Anxiety Disorder 7 items，GAD-7)评估]和抑郁[采用患者健康问卷9项(Patient Health Questionnaire 9 items，PHQ-9)评估]状态。同时记录并比较2组并发症发生情况及疼痛复发率。结果2组患者治疗后各时间点的VAS、AIS、GAD-7及PHQ-9评分均较治疗前显著下降(均P<0.001)。术后1周时，2组各项评分差异均无统计学意义(均P>0.05)。术后1个月、3个月、6个月及12个月时，CRF组患者的VAS显著低于PRF组(均P<0.001)，且AIS、GAD-7及PHQ-9评分亦低于PRF组(均P<0.05)。CRF组术后感觉局部麻木的发生率高于PRF组(P<0.05)，但其疼痛复发率(1年内)低于PRF组(P<0.05)。结论CRF与PRF均可有效缓解老年PHN患者的疼痛，改善其睡眠质量和焦虑、抑郁状态，但CRF中长期疗效优于PRF。 带状疱疹后神经痛(postherpetic neuralgia，PHN)是指带状疱疹(herpes zoster，HZ)皮损愈合后疼痛持续超过1个月的慢性疼痛综合征。多数患者长期遭受剧烈疼痛困扰，即使应用一线药物治疗(如钙通道调节剂普瑞巴林、钠离子调节剂利多卡因贴剂等)，疼痛仍然控制不佳。介入治疗技术，如连续射频术(continuous radiofrequency，CRF)、脉冲射频术(pulsed radiofrequency，PRF)及神经电刺激(如脊髓电刺激)等，为PHN的治疗提供了重要支持。现有研究[1-4]证实CRF与PRF均能有效缓解PHN患者的疼痛症状。然而，对这2种技术治疗老年胸段PHN疗效的系统性比较研究相对缺乏。本研究旨在系统评估CRF与PRF治疗老年胸段PHN患者的镇痛效果，并分析其对患者睡眠质量及心理状态的影响，以期为临床治疗方案的选择提供参考依据。 资料与方法 伦理声明 本研究已获得西安交通大学第一附属医院伦理委员会批准(审批号：KYLLSL-2022-205)。 一般资料 回顾性收集2020年3月至2022年3月就诊于西安交通大学第一附属医院疼痛科的181例老年(年龄>60岁)胸段PHN患者，按照接受的治疗方式分为CRF组(n=101)和PRF组(n=80)。记录患者的年龄、性别、病程、身高、体重、术前视觉模拟评分(Visual Analogue Scale，VAS)，吸烟、饮酒、高血压、糖尿病史及术后并发症情况，分别于术后1周、1个月、3个月、6个月、12个月随访患者的疼痛情况、睡眠质量、心理状态，比较2组患者的治疗效果。 纳入和排除标准 纳入标准：1)年龄>60周岁；2)胸2~12神经支配区域带状疱疹感染；3)疼痛持续时间>1个月；4)常规保守药物治疗4周效果不佳(包括抗癫痫、抗抑郁及阿片类药物等)；5)术前VAS>5。 排除标准：1)有恶性肿瘤病史；2)自身免疫性疾病未控制者；3)随访数据不完整；4)术前或随访期间接受过神经介入性治疗；5)主观不配合随访评估或死亡者。患者入组及随访流程如图1所示。 患者入组及随访流程图 Figure 1 Flow chart of patient enrollment and follow-up CRF: Continuous radiofrequency;
